content.bridge_context: Exploring the interior structure and composition of our planet.

units.title: Layers of the Earth
units.explanation: Crust (outermost), Mantle (middle), Core (innermost). Like an onion or a boiled egg.
units.dual_language_instruction: Draw the layers of the Earth. / पृथ्वी की परतों का चित्र बनाएं।

units.title: Rocks and Minerals
units.explanation: The crust is made of rocks. Rocks are made of minerals.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify a common mineral used in pencils. / पेंसिल में प्रयुक्त एक सामान्य खनिज की पहचान करें।
